englishText: What does it take to make IT truly work?
chineseText: 怎样才能让 IT 真正发生？
visualIntent: 黑场逐渐出现城市、机房和办公空间的微弱光线。
generationPrompt: Pre-dawn modern Asian city and quiet enterprise office, then a real data-center aisle waking as practical indicator lights appear, slow controlled push-in, deep neutral shadows, no dramatic failure imagery.

englishText: Not just products. Not just promises.
chineseText: 不只是产品，也不只是承诺。
visualIntent: 网络机柜、会议空间、门禁与运营大屏克制切换。
generationPrompt: Quiet network rack, access-control reader, empty meeting room and operations wall coming online through match cuts, calm dependable atmosphere, all screens defocused and unreadable.

englishText: It takes planning, integration and people who stay accountable.
chineseText: 它需要规划、集成，以及始终负责到底的人。
visualIntent: 工程师查看图纸、与客户讨论并核对设备。
generationPrompt: Asian and international IT engineers reviewing a paper network plan with a client at a real enterprise site, then verifying cables and rack equipment, accountable collaboration, natural gestures.

englishText: Since 2010, JOTO has helped enterprises make IT happen.
chineseText: 自 2010 年起，JOTO 持续帮助企业让 IT 真正发生。
visualIntent: 上海城市与项目团队，为 2010 至今的后期时间线留白。
generationPrompt: Contemporary Shanghai skyline at working-hour dawn, diverse enterprise project team walking into a bright project space, confident but understated, leave negative space for a 2010-to-present timeline graphic.

visualIntent: 园区、分支与数据中心之间建立稳定连接。
generationPrompt: Network engineer connecting an enterprise campus, branch office and data-center rack through practical installation actions, clean patch panels and fiber handling, stable connectivity, lateral match movement.

visualIntent: 身份、终端、网络和安全运营场景。
generationPrompt: Security operations analyst and IT engineer reviewing endpoint, identity and network protection in a realistic SOC, screens intentionally soft and unreadable, composed alert response, no crisis.

visualIntent: 服务器、存储与关键工作负载稳定运行。
generationPrompt: Realistic server and storage infrastructure running steadily, engineer checks status lights and hot-swap bays without removing hardware, slow dolly, precise professional environment.

chineseText: 让每一个团队保持协同。
visualIntent: 不同国家团队进行会议与关键通信。
generationPrompt: International teams collaborating across a modern meeting room and video conference, active listening and practical decision-making, screens unreadable, warm human energy without staged celebration.

visualIntent: 门禁、视频监控、园区与办公设施。
generationPrompt: Modern office entrance access control, discreet CCTV installation and professional security control room, realistic devices without vendor marks, calm protected environment.

englishText: From the first blueprint to 24×7 operations.
chineseText: 从第一张蓝图，到 7×24 小时持续运营。
visualIntent: 咨询、采购、部署、巡检和远程支持形成连续动作。
generationPrompt: A coherent enterprise IT lifecycle montage: blueprint consultation, equipment handoff, careful rack installation, on-site inspection and remote support, match-cut through hands and tools, same visual palette.

visualIntent: 多地团队交叉剪辑，为后期抽象地图线路留白。
generationPrompt: Multinational IT teams working in Shanghai, Tokyo, Singapore and London-like business environments, coordinated handoffs across time zones, subtle travel and remote operations cues, leave open composition for abstract map lines, no city labels.

englishText: So people stay connected. Operations stay resilient. Growth keeps moving.
chineseText: 让团队保持连接，让运营持续稳定，让业务不断向前。
visualIntent: 学校、零售、实验室、制造和国际办公环境稳定运转。
generationPrompt: Resilient operations across an international school, premium retail store, modern laboratory, advanced manufacturing floor and global office, people working naturally while technology remains quietly reliable, cohesive montage.

chineseText: 我们一起，让 IT 真正发生。
visualIntent: 客户与 JOTO 团队共同检查已完成的项目现场。
generationPrompt: JOTO-like engineers and a client walking through a completed enterprise server and collaboration environment, checking the finished project together, warm confident light, shared accomplishment, no visible branding.

englishText: JOTO Global | We Make IT Happen.
chineseText: JOTO Global｜让 IT 真正发生。
visualIntent: 深色到绿色的品牌渐变与纯文字标志。
